label: It is impossible that there be no first mover: no being that moves…, via from being in act
meaning: The prima via from the literal reading of 'nisi per aliquod ens in actu' instead of the two premises 'whatever is moved has a mover' and 'every mover is in act in the respect'. Six premises instead of seven, and the new one is strictly weaker than the two it replaces (AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-BEING-IN-ACT-READING-FACTS). The Comparator config also verifies premisesNeeded: dropping any one premise leaves a finite model without a mover moved by none. This connects results and closes no frontier node: the root route still uses STMT-NOTHING-MOVES-EXCEPT-AS-IN-ACT for its attribute steps, so the root's premise set is unchanged.

strong_version_needed.1e47e6db-da06-5a40-9ccf-fbd1f929c596: For this exact encoded interface, the literal being-in-act reduction is also satisfied by the existing weak model; replacing only the strong per-se link still does not yield absolute unmovedness. Checked by PRIMA-VIA-WEAK-CONSUMER-BOUNDARIES. This scope does not extend to arbitrary added attribute/historical premises, nor establish the strong premise philosophically. See docs/notes/prima-via-strength-consumers.md.
